Comparison figure of the precession-constant test

Source: R/test_tuned.R
plot_test_k.Rd

Plots the result of test_tuned: the MTM spectrum with the AstroGeo22 periods, search windows and the peaks used (A), k, Earth-Moon distance and length of day against AstroGeo22 and the Devonian composite (B-D), AstroGeo22 through time with the estimate and optional published constraints (E-G), and the pre-scan of the record.

Usage

plot_test_k(res, constraints = NULL, age_ma = res$spec$age_ma)

Arguments

res

Result to plot (required, no default): the list returned by test_tuned.

constraints

Path to a CSV file of published constraints drawn in panels E-G (character, or NULL for none); see constraints in test_tuned for the columns. Default=NULL.

age_ma

Age of the record in Ma (numeric), where the estimate is drawn in panels E-G and at which AstroGeo22 is evaluated. Default=res$spec$age_ma, the age used in test_tuned.

Value

Called for its plot.
